integrity: All assertions and source attributions are limited to the stated public theorems and an explicit, independently replayable finite checker; no claim of external certification or authorial priority.
scientific_limitations: Derived exact age and orbit enumeration for the particular M_3 hypergraph, not a classification of arbitrary set-homogeneous hypergraphs. Structural homogeneity and automorphism results are cited, while tree enumeration and edge-count recursion are proved here; bounded computations are supplementary. Catalan numbers and the ungraded OEIS A052886 sequence are known. Independent mathematical audit has not been performed. Every possible edge count occurs for n>=6 by the proved singleton-graft induction.
title: Edge-graded Catalan age of the set-homogeneous three-hypergraph
